## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix `select_failures` so it matches report paths the way `select_explicit` does: today a report path with a `./` prefix never matches, so those failed tests are silently skipped.

## Changes
The pull request adds `select_failures`, which selects requested paths from a runner report's `failed` list. It also turns two existing helpers into list comprehensions and adds the first tests for all three selectors.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize report paths before the membership check — `select_failures({"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}, {"tests/test_x.py"})` returns `[]` because it tests `path in requested` on the raw path. `select_explicit` at `app/selection.py:6` preserves the original spelling but matches on `normalize(path)`. The added test at `tests/test_selection.py:43` uses only unprefixed paths, so it misses this. — When a runner reports `./`-prefixed paths, the failed tests are dropped from the rerun with no error. — Fix: Use `normalize(path) in requested`, as `select_explicit` does, and add a `./`-prefixed case to `test_failure_report_selection`.
